items.headline: UK regulator finds ticket reseller Viagogo likely used hidden ‘drip pricing’
items.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority’s provisional investigation suggests Viagogo added undisclosed fees to ticket prices, a practice that could breach consumer‑protection law and affect millions of concertgoers. The case underscores growing scrutiny of online marketplaces’ pricing transparency.
